meta.title: 新手咖啡拉花 摆动怎么练？（10分钟详细讲解）
meta.title_en: Latte Art for Beginners | How to Practice Swinging (10-Min Guide)
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 摆动练习

scenes.context: 两指捏缸：手臂抬高，大小臂90°。第一种握法用两指捏住缸柄，手臂抬高，大小臂呈90度。语域：咖啡教学，姿势讲解。
sentences: Pinch the pitcher with two fingers, arm raised.
Upper and lower arm form 90 degrees.
A raised arm swings more freely.
paraphrase: 捏缸 → pinch the pitcher / two-finger grip
大小臂90度 → 90-degree arm bend / a right angle
scenes.speak: Pinch the pitcher with two fingers, arm raised. Upper and lower arm form 90 degrees. A raised arm swings more freely.

scenes.context: 握拳式：手肘靠近身体，手腕发力。第二种握法像握拳一样握住缸，手肘贴近身体，主要用手腕发力。语域：咖啡教学，姿势讲解。
sentences: The fist grip: elbow close to your body.
power from the wrist（手腕发力）
A different grip can feel easier.
paraphrase: 握拳式 → the fist grip / holding like a fist
手肘贴近 → elbow close to / tuck the elbow
scenes.speak: The fist grip: elbow close to your body. Power comes from the wrist. A different grip can feel easier.

scenes.context: 原地定点摆动练习。在同一个点反复摆动，练出稳定频率。语域：咖啡教学，练习方法。
sentences: Practice swinging in one fixed spot.
Swing again and again at the same point.
paraphrase: 定点摆动 → swing in place / spot-swing
稳定频率 → a steady rhythm / consistent pace
scenes.speak: Practice swinging in one fixed spot. Swing again and again at the same point. Build a steady rhythm.

scenes.title_en: Frequency Check: Too Fast Breaks the Lines
scenes.context: 左边错误vs右边正确：频率太慢导致线条断裂。稍微放松状态下摆动最流畅。语域：咖啡教学，正反对比。
sentences: 频率太慢，线条就会断裂。
Too slow a pace and the lines break.
Left is wrong; right is right.
A relaxed hand swings the smoothest.
paraphrase: 线条断裂 → the lines break / broken lines
scenes.speak: Too slow a pace and the lines break. Left is wrong; right is right. A relaxed hand swings the smoothest.

shifts: 用 pinch the pitcher（两指捏缸）、the fist grip（握拳式）、tuck the elbow（收肘）
用 one fixed spot（定点）、steady rhythm（稳定频率）、swing in place（原地摆动）
